channel.title: Kitzur Shulchan Aruch with Rabbi Shmuel Weiner
channel.description: A short daily shiur on the Kitzur Shulchan Aruch with Rabbi Shmuel Weiner of Khal Zichron Nosson Tzvi in Jerusalem. Each episode takes a few simanim and explains the halachos clearly and practically, in about 5 to 20 minutes. The series starts at the beginning, with the halachos of waking up and getting dressed, and moves through the day: washing, tefilin, tzitzis, mezuzah, brachos, and tefillah.
